notes: Read all 52 numbered source lines before editing. The file is a non-visual tour-definition config: a browser-only navigate() helper (L4-9), a STEPS: TourStep[] array (L11-41), and the AUTOMATIONS_TOUR: TourDefinition export (L43-52).

Imports L1-2: `TourDefinition` from @/lib/tourRegistry and `TourStep` from @/hooks/useTour. navigate() L4-9 (browser-only): web pushed window.history.pushState + dispatched a synthetic PopStateEvent, guarded by `typeof window === 'undefined'` (SSR) and `window.location.pathname === href` (same-path). SSR guard and same-path early-return are browser-specific and dropped; the call-site href is preserved verbatim, matching the established PresetGallery/Layout native-navigate parity pattern.
